source.attribution: Amy S. Nowacki, Licorice Gargle Dataset, TSHS Resources Portal (2017); Ruetzler et al., Anesthesia & Analgesia 117:614-621 (2013)
source.observations: 235 real adult trial participants, one row per participant; generated P0001-P0235 keys preserve source row order

independent_conversion_check.comparison: All 19 observed source columns, row order, numerical values and missingness must agree with original RDA. Mirror is not the authoritative task source.

cohort.outcome: pacu30min_throatPain, recorded 0-10 sore-throat score at rest 30 minutes after PACU arrival
cohort.response_event: Observed outcome equals zero, meaning no sore throat at that time point
cohort.missingness: Use the same complete cases for age, BMI, recorded gender, arm and 30-minute outcome in every model; exclude two missing outcomes without imputation. Emit NA for their missing cohort response indicators.
cohort.range_note: The package manual rounds the BMI range to 16-36; these exact extrema come from the original RDA and checked CSV mirror.

models.estimator: Unpenalized binomial-logit maximum likelihood, no interaction, model-based inverse observed-information standard errors, two-sided normal Wald tests
models.comparison: AIC across all models; one-degree-of-freedom likelihood-ratio tests only for each nested reduced model versus joint

limitations: The endpoint is prevention of a recorded postoperative symptom, not remission from a chronic disease. Age/BMI associations are conditional on model covariates and do not establish treatment-response heterogeneity or clinical utility.
